title: Metadata tree: discover how your service desk is built
goal: Inspect your training configuration, trace a reference type and prepare a separate verified copy before changes.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: Two windows expose different aspects
paragraphs: Enterprise contains your actual customers and requests. Designer describes which object kinds and fields exist and the types permitted in them. Клиенты in the tree describes a catalog; it is not the individual Учебный Север item. One description supports many items.

Close Enterprise for your base and select Конфигуратор in the launcher. If the tree is hidden choose Конфигурация → Открыть конфигурацию. An empty work area before opening the tree does not establish missing development. The first inspection adds or updates nothing.

sections.title: From a form field to metadata
paragraphs: The tree describes the relationship; the form holds its selected value.

Type: СправочникСсылка.Клиенты → existing catalog item.
code.output: The field description is distinguished from the selected item and its permitted reference type.

sections.title: Five objects in one training story
paragraphs: Under Справочники locate Клиенты and Услуги, the persistent participants. Under Документы locate ЗаявкаУслуги, a dated and numbered request. Перечисления → СтатусыЗаявки defines prepared status values. Отчеты → ЗаявкиПоКлиентам presents already saved facts. The УчебнаяСлужба subsystem gathers commands into a section.

An empty Регистры накопления category does not prove this package implements accumulation accounting. General platform categories remain available in a small configuration. Do not claim movements, posting or accounting merely because the category exists; inspect concrete objects and behavior.

sections.title: An attribute holds a typed value
paragraphs: Expand Документы → ЗаявкаУслуги → Реквизиты and inspect Клиент. Its type is СправочникСсылка.Клиенты, which explains selecting an existing catalog item instead of storing similar name text. Renaming that item retains the relationship until another customer is selected.

Compare Услуга, ДлительностьМинут and Статус: another catalog reference, a number and an enumeration value serve different purposes. A numeric type alone does not specify units; minutes are established separately by the model and validation. Technical names serve code and synonyms serve the user interface; avoid accidental edits while inspecting.

sections.title: An empty category does not implement accounting
paragraphs: Platform categories support future development; they are not a ready business model.

code.source: Регистры накопления exists as a category but contains no objects from this package.
code.output: Movements or balances cannot be declared implemented.

sections.title: Begin changes with a verified copy
paragraphs: Before the first structural change export your continuing work through Администрирование → Выгрузить информационную базу…. Save a .dt in a separate clearly named folder and wait for success. It contains configuration and data; .cf does not replace a request-data backup.

Create a new infobase without configuration in the launcher, with a distinct name and new folder. In its Designer use Администрирование → Загрузить информационную базу… with your .dt. Restoration replaces its target, so use only the new empty base. Retain the original and export; do not copy a running 1Cv8.1CD in Explorer as a substitute.

sections.title: Restore proves the backup
paragraphs: Open the new copy in Enterprise. Compare customer codes, request numbers, durations and comments, then generate the familiar report. The sequential four-request dataset gives 4/120; use your independent expectation for additional work. Continue later lessons in this copy only after reconciliation.

Keep a short record: original name, copy name, export date, platform version, control numbers and total. Nexus retains your lesson and self-report but cannot observe the external base or automatically certify restoration. Studio and source transfer are unnecessary for this inspection.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Клиенты in Designer is mistaken for one customer item. Separate the catalog description from its many Enterprise items.
Only a .cf is saved to back up requests. Export a .dt and verify restoration in a new empty base.
A general category is mistaken for an implemented accounting register. Inspect concrete objects and observed application behavior.

practice.title: Read metadata and prepare a copy for changes
practice.task: Export and restore a .dt into a separate base; reconcile numbers, fields and report.
practice.environment: Official installed 1C, your own synthetic training data; no code editing.
practice.externalRoute: 1C launcher → Designer for your infobase, then a separate new copy

steps.title: Open Designer
steps.action: Close Enterprise for your base, select it and choose Конфигуратор. If the tree is absent use Конфигурация → Открыть конфигурацию.
steps.why: Open application descriptions while retaining data.
steps.expected: The root and catalog, document, enumeration and report categories are visible.
steps.troubleshooting: Verify the selected infobase; a closed tree does not mean you must create another configuration.
steps.before: Official training 1C is installed; your preceding infobase and recorded control numbers/totals are available.

steps.title: Locate the concrete objects
steps.action: Expand Справочники, Документы, Перечисления and Отчеты. Record Клиенты, Услуги, ЗаявкаУслуги, СтатусыЗаявки and ЗаявкиПоКлиентам with their roles.
steps.why: Separate entities, facts, state values and presentation.
steps.troubleshooting: An earlier package can lack the report; use the preceding lesson’s optional preservation route rather than inventing an identically named object.
steps.before: The root and catalog, document, enumeration and report categories are visible.

figures.caption: Own-copy Designer: Клиенты is under Справочники. This is the catalog description, not an individual customer item.
figures.alt: Own-copy Designer: Клиенты is under Справочники. This is the catalog description, not an individual customer item.

steps.title: Trace the customer type
steps.action: Inspect Тип and connect it to Справочники → Клиенты. Compare Услуга, ДлительностьМинут and Статус.
steps.why: A typed reference establishes the relationship, not similar captions.
steps.expected: Клиент is СправочникСсылка.Клиенты; other field types are explained.
steps.troubleshooting: Read without editing Тип; close the object window retaining its description.

steps.title: Export the original
steps.action: Choose Выгрузить информационную базу…, save a separate .dt and wait for success. Close original Designer.
steps.why: Preserve data and structure before the first change.
steps.expected: A completed .dt exists; the original launcher entry remains.
steps.troubleshooting: Stop on export failure; .cf and a source ZIP do not replace this step.
steps.before: Клиент is СправочникСсылка.Клиенты; other field types are explained.

steps.title: Restore only into a new copy
steps.where: Launcher → Добавить → new infobase without configuration
steps.action: Create Моя служба — изменения in a new folder. Open its Designer and use Администрирование → Загрузить информационную базу… with your .dt. Verify the NEW target name before confirming.
steps.why: Restoration must not replace original work.
steps.expected: A separate copy is restored; original and .dt retained.
steps.troubleshooting: Cancel when the target is the original; create a genuinely separate empty base.
steps.before: A completed .dt exists; the original launcher entry remains.

steps.title: Verify continuity
steps.action: Open previous cards and requests by your actual codes/numbers; compare fields and report with the control table. Record the copy name for later lessons.
steps.why: A .dt file alone does not prove a usable restore.
steps.expected: Previous work is available; the sequential report remains 4/120.
steps.troubleshooting: Retain discrepancies and return to the original rather than changing data to hide them.
steps.before: A separate copy is restored; original and .dt retained.

criteria: A customer item is not called metadata; a report is not called a new request.
Actual types and reasons recorded without changing properties.
Original and backup retained, target separate and comparison documented.
Five-object record and the attribute-to-reference-type path.
Original/copy names, synthetic control numbers and reconciliation result.
If the original is selected as the restore target, cancel instead of replacing it.
